title: Accept SPACEBAR as a valid way of actioning a component
body: Currently when you TAB to a given component, you have to press ENTER to activate it.  It may be worthwhile also accepting SPACE as a valid character for activating the component.  That is, currently if you press ENTER on the list box, it expands.  It would be good if SPACE did the same to be consistent, for example, with using TAB to reach a button and simply pressing SPACE.
author: jchristn
